institutes.equipmentNotes: FMT internal regulations (July 2022) require a white cotton lab coat (blouse blanche) during TP and TD, and attire compliant with health/hygiene/safety rules allowing identification. For clinical internships (stages), a clean buttoned white coat with an ID badge is part of the dress code (FMT objectives & regulations page). No official list of personal medical instruments (e.g. stethoscope) was found. Sources: https://fmt.rnu.tn/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Reglement-interieur-FMT_juillet-2022_VF.pdf , https://fmt.rnu.tn/en/objectifs-et-reglement-en/
institutes.notes: FMT course page says its online teaching platform is on utm.uvt.tn (Virtual University of Tunis); older 2019 list pointed to ent.uvt.rnu.tn. Stage platform reported at stages-fmt.rnu.tn. Orientation code 210700 from orientini. Student guide available in FR and EN. Official Facebook page not confirmed; the listed one ('Faculté de Medecine de Tunis', ~9.7K likes) is a best guess.

calendars.title: Calendrier national de l'année universitaire 2026-2027 (Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur) - applies to UTM establishments
calendars.summary: Rentrée 1 Sept 2026 for prep institutes, engineering schools, medicine faculties (relevant: IPEIEM, ENIT, FMT); 12 Sept 2026 for other establishments. Min. 28 teaching weeks. Winter break 12-27 Dec 2026; spring break 19 Mar - 4 Apr 2027. Holidays: 15 Oct 2026, 17 Dec 2026, 1 Jan 2027, 20 Mar 2027, 9 Apr 2027, 1 May 2027; Eid dates TBD. No exam periods given. No UTM-specific calendar found.
